name: trigger-capture-arms
activation: Each arm version's real activation instant is written by production to experiment_arms.activated_at the first time the engine starts after deploy. Only positions opened at or after it exist. The EXP-2.0 Indicator arms keep their versions and activation instants (unchanged).
status_at_freeze: BUILT, NOT MERGED, NOT ACTIVE (branch feat/a3-of1-arms)
what_this_is: MEASUREMENT, NOT A STRATEGY CHANGE. No A3 or OF1 rule is changed: the evidence did not support a V2 for either (analysis/a3-of1-2026-10-23/a3_of1_diagnosis.md). These arms give option-level outcomes to every routed A3 / OF1 candidate, including those that lose production arbitration or meet a held production slot.

code.engine: apps/server/src/services/experiment-engine.ts (triggerCandidates, one position per arm per routed candidate)
code.candidate_builder: apps/server/src/services/market-bias.ts buildTriggerExperimentCandidate (runs buildStructureContract, the production structure chain's own contract build)

candidate_stream: The router's MULTIPATH family candidates with triggerId A3 / OF1 on each production poll (paper stage, computed before the production slot logic), built side-effect free behind the production structure chain's stateless gates: risk-off when enabled, feed quality, session window, reliability, sequence check, pre-mint check. Each routed candidate (lifecycleId) is taken at most once per arm.

independent_state_per_arm.slot: one open official position per symbol+mode
independent_state_per_arm.cooldowns: the baseline's rules applied to the arm's OWN official stop-outs
independent_state_per_arm.exits: target; stop with trailing; SWEEP_RECLAIMED (a closed 15m bar after entry back beyond the sweep extreme, as production's triggerSlotAction); session end. No bias-reversal exit (production has none for trigger trades).
independent_state_per_arm.divergence_from_production: TRIGGER_REVERSAL (an opposite trigger claim later in the poll) is not replicated; 1 occurrence in the trigger trade history.

A3R.rule: every routed A3 candidate, production rules

OF1R.rule: every routed OF1 candidate, production rules

ledgers: Official (FILL-1.0: decision mid entry, target at min(LTP, target), other exits at LTP, the official cost model) and simulated (ask entry, bid exits, target only when the bid reaches it, fresh quote <= 60 s exchange age or <= 15 s receipt, >= 1 lot; otherwise NOT_OPENED / EXIT_PENDING / UNRESOLVED), reported apart. Same as EXP-2.0.

comparisons.replication: A3R / OF1R positions vs production A3 / OF1 trades in the same period, matched on candidateId = lifecycleId
comparisons.arbitration_losses: positions whose arbitrationRole is not SELECTED, reported apart
comparisons.hypotheses: analysis/a3-of1-2026-10-23/hypotheses.json (A3-OF1-HYP-1.0), each at its own minimum session count

counting: Open, EXIT_PENDING, NOT_OPENED and UNRESOLVED positions are counted, never given a return. Exchange-session bootstrap, 90%.
promotion: none automatic; any rule change is a separate proposal
